newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine central gov't Feb deficit $269.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine central gov't Feb deficit $269.5 mln.

text.p: The Argentine central government's deficit for February was $269.5 million versus $14 million the same month last year, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
Total income was $1.116 billion against total expenditure of $1.386 billion, compared to income last February of $1.369 billion versus spending of $1.383 billion.
Current income for the month was $1.115 billion compared to current expenditure of $1.287 billion, while capital income was $1.3 million versus capital spending of $98.1 million.
In the current revenue breakdown, tax income was $1.086 billion versus $1.138 billion in February 1996.
In the spending breakdown, wages were $388.1 million versus $318.3 million one year earlier and interest payments were $252.8 million versus $132.6 million one year earlier.
In January, the Argentine treasury deficit was $423 million, which was 18.4 percent higher than in Jan 1996.
